articleTitle: Face recognition based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Face recognition is of great importance to real world applications such as video surveillance, human machine interaction and security systems. As compared to traditional machine learning approaches, deep learning based methods have shown better performances in terms of accuracy and speed of processing in image recognition. This paper proposes a modified Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture by adding two normalization operations to two of the layers. The normalization operation which is batch normalization provided acceleration of the network. CNN architecture was employed to extract distinctive face features and Softmax classifier was used to classify faces in the fully connected layer of CNN. In the experiment part, Georgia Tech Database showed that the proposed approach has improved the face recognition performance with better recognition results.

articleTitle: Designing of induction heaters for the edges of pre-rolled wide ultrafine sheets and strips correlated with the chilling end-effect
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article provides the analysis of the structures of broadband hot rolling mills that confirmed the relevance of the use of induction heating of the pre-roll edges before the finishing mills in order to reduce the chilling end-effect. Adaptation to the production conditions of wide ultrafine sheets and strips of finite-difference recurrence mathematical model of temperature field variation allowed to develop recommendations for designing of slot inductors for reheating the edges of pre-rolled strips, taking into account the chilling end-effect of the edges, heating modes to achieve the required temperature distribution before rolling in the finishing mill groups. Calculations show that the temperature gradient across the strip width is from 30 to 150 Celsius degrees, depends on the time interval between the end of the rough rolling and the beginning of the deformation of the metal in the finishing mill. Special design of slot inductors makes possible to eliminate a temperature gradient.

articleTitle: The analysis of the process of the laboratory practicum fulfillment and the assessment of its efficiency on the basis of the distance function
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the method of the analysis of the process of the laboratory work fulfillment by students and the assessment of its efficiency on the basis of the distance function. The criteria for the assessment of the efficiency of the student's work performance are developed with the use of Euler's, Hemming's and Chebyshev's functions. The separate functions influence on the total assessment criterion has been assessed. The obtained results make it possible to quantitatively assess the process of the fulfillment of the work from “bad” to “very good”.

articleTitle: The parallel data processing by nucleo board with STM32 microcontrollers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Parallel data processing is a fast data manipulation. Input data are processed by multiple devices due to speed and job allocation for individual devices. This paper describes using of parallel processing input values by two microcontroller STM32F446RE and microcontroller STM32F746ZG which is presented as a master device. The other microcontrollers are slaves. This device processing input logic status from 32 input buttons that makes 32-bit word. There is master/slave architecture, where slaves scan the pins and send the status to the master device. The primary advantage of parallel processing is dividing of tasks between two or more processors and it means that each processor can operates independently with a smaller number of operations. This advantage does not burden the processor such as if only one processor operates. As result it was created equipment for educational purposes to train specialists in the field of data processing.

articleTitle: Android application supporting developed web applications testing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents Android application that simplifies the process of testing web applications in mobile environments, shortens time needed for this testing and this way saves resources needed for application development. In the first part, the paper contains information about software testing. It defines what testing is, describes goals, purpose and objectives of the software testing. Further, it analyzes testing automation and effectivity of the software testing. The main part of the paper is devoted to Android application itself. Example of the testing process is provided, starting with scanning a QR code, which leads Android application to a test protocol in JSON file format. Two main test automation features are introduced - running unit tests of web application and running a test protocol cycle, which means running all tests specified in the test protocol. In the last part, generated outputs of such testing process are characterized together with possibilities of including tester's remarks in the form of text comments and application screenshot to the final report.

articleTitle: Current ripple comparison of multi and single phase Buck-boost converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the paper, a six phase interleaved noninverting buck-boost converter is presented and compared with a single phase one. The results are presented in simulation and experimental environment. Each leg of the converter is operating in parallel. The topology of multiphase buck-boost converter is suitable for many applications where high power with low interference is needed. Both single phase and multiphase converters are controlled with an ARM (Advanced RISC Machine) microcontroller in an experimental environment. Same electrical components are used for achieving valid results. From simulation and experimental results, it is possible to see that the multiphase converter is more suitable where lower current ripple with relatively cheap components is required.

articleTitle: Interaction between magnetic and stress field in ferromagnetic core of magnetoelastic pressure force sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with approximate solution of interaction between magnetic and stress fields in the ferromagnetic core of magnetoelastic sensor. The application of mechanical compressive force to the sensor results in mechanical stress within the core body and produces the variation of material permeability due to mechanical stress. The deformation of the magnetic field distribution and magnetic flux density caused by mechanical stress is given in graphical form.

articleTitle: Starting torque of variable frequency electric drive
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The thesis deals with analyzing modes of the induction motor breakaway in the system “frequency changer - induction motor”. The authors establish that the stator winding heating occurs slower when forming the cyclic starting moment compared to the heating in the prolonged operating mode of the induction motor with the stalled rotor that allows doing multiple breakaway attempts with increasing the starting moment due to the short-terms excess of the starting moment value. The conducted experiments of the induction motor capabilities powered with frequency changer determine that there is such correlation between frequency and supply voltage when receiving values of the starting moment with the specified overload coefficient that the stator current has a minimal value.

articleTitle: Safety system for intelligent building
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with safety system for intelligent building created by means of secondary devices on the example of attiny2313 or Arduino NANO. Communication between control panel and secondary devices considered to be carried out by UART interface. If it is necessary to use more secondary devices the necessity of use multiplexer and (de)multiplexer for communication by means UART interface was grounded. The advantage of system designed in this way is that for safety respectively to replace any of the secondary devices do not lead to change of the entire ESS but only the part that should be replaced. Exchange for example because of the secondary part does not dispose with a sufficient amount of pins for other devices respectively, enhancement of the secondary device with sensor that needs to communicate multiple pins. It means that the software part will be change only to the part which is dedicated to the particular secondary device.

articleTitle: The alteration of the energy parameters and losses components of electric machines in the process of their aging
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The approaches to the determination of the energy indices of electric machines basic types via separate loss components in the function of their integral and instantaneous values are proposed. Their adequacy is confirmed and the special features of their use at the alteration of electric machine structural units and elements in the course of long-term operation and repairs are substantiated. The problem of the assessment of the change of the energy parameters of electric machines in the course of their aging is solved at the qualitative level.

articleTitle: The technology of production of a copper — aluminum — copper composite to produce current lead buses of the high — voltage plants
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In recent years, the process of improving the contact connections is faster due to the widespread use of the pressed and welded contact joints, the use of copper cladded aluminum disc springs and bolted contact connections. The replacement of copper elements with bimetallic aluminum-copper ones allows reducing copper consumption by 60-80 per cent, reducing the weight of the current loaded elements of the electrical equipment and devices by 30-45 per cent, reducing the cost by 20-45 per cent.

articleTitle: Droop methods for parallel co-working of DC/DC converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with issue of parallel connection of more DC/DC converters. The article contains theoretical overview of one group of methods designed for proper functioning of parallel connected converters. The main advantage of referred methods is their simplicity. In some cases they fully satisfy requirements and they can be used for correct functioning of parallel power stages. Following part is dedicated to analysis of the one method by computer simulations. Analyzed method with current feedback has proved to be operational. Current-sharing can be ensured if current reference value is set at correct value for certain load. The results of the simulation showed that for 5Ω load and 20V of required output voltage is the 1A of reference current value just right. But when output resistive is increased, reference current value should be set more tightly (at the lower value). However then it can cause fall of the output voltage. It is why the droop methods increase current-sharing abilities, but makes worse output voltage regulation.

articleTitle: The determination of the condition of the windings of electric machines with long mean-time-between failures
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The nature of the turn-to-turn short circuit in the windings of electric machines with long mean-time-between failures is specified. The choice of the methods for the diagnostics of the presence of short-circuited turns in the windings of electric machines in the process of their repair and current operation is substantiated. The structure of the system of short-circuited turn diagnostics is grounded being based on the proposed methods. The solution to the posed problem is considered taking into account the electric machine magnetic system real condition characterized by the deterioration of its magnetic and electrical properties. The results are verified by the experiments with the use of a computer-aided measuring system.

articleTitle: Remote control of electromechanical systems based on computer simulators
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers remote control of electromechanical systems via the Internet using the National Instruments LabVIEW technology. As control objects, laboratory stands for electromechanics for students of technical specialties have been adopted. For real stands, their virtual counterparts are created. Using LabVIEW technology enables through virtual analogue stand remotely manage online real electromechanical equipment, conduct research of its static and dynamic modes. The results of the development and use of virtual laboratory complexes in the educational process and scientific research have been summed up. The use of virtual complexes as part of methodological support of educational disciplines in the direction of electromechanics is considered.

articleTitle: Hybrid capacitive sensors for the monitoring system of hydro- and turbo generator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, hybrid capacitive sensors for the electric machines faults monitoring system are investigated. This sensor combines the advantages of fiber optic and microelectronic technologies. Optical powering and data transfer is a key for enable development of simple and economic primary sensor for monitoring, control system which have immune to electromagnetic fields, have low thermal and mechanical inertia, have immune to electrical noise and e.t.c. Sensor application for the measurement mechanical parameters fault in the hydro-and turbo generator (air gap and core compression ratio) was determined. The presented system makes available development of hybrid capacitive sensor for control system of mechanical parameters of hydro- and turbo generators. The purposed design hybrid capacitive sensor can be easily adapted for measurement of various mechanical parameters of hydro- and turbo generators.

articleTitle: Design of motor speed controller of electronic commutation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with a brief description of the motors with electronic commutation and with motor control. It focuses on the description of the construction of the basic types of these motors. It also describes the essential parts of electronic devices, enabling the control as well as the main types of sensored motor control. The aim is to implement the chosen method using the board Arduino Mega 2560. The sensorless control method based on the back electromotive force (EMF-B) zero crossing measurement was chosen for this purpose. The selected method is based on the comparison of the voltage with the virtual neutral point of the motor. The proposal described in the paper finds its application in various branches of industry, as for designs of various machine tools and industrial lines where BLDC motors are mounted, as well as in industry where it is necessary to drive the motor speed control.

articleTitle: Boundary surface of Chua's circuit in 3D state space
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with the visualization of chaotic attractors and boundary surfaces generated for different parameters in Chua's circuit. These objects were visualized by ParaView open-source tool. Boundary surfaces were reconstructed from the point cloud by filters which ParaView offers. The point cloud was filtered from the dozens of calculated partial 2D cross-sections of state space. The article illustrates the possibilities to use the free software with high-quality graphics output when analyzing both autonomous and non-autonomous circuits. This can help to accurately illustrate the reason for failing circuits or to clarify the principle of their operation. This software can be also used in other areas including electrical engineering and electro-mechanics.

articleTitle: Control of the electric drive under conditions of parametric uncertainty and coordinates' interrelation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The introduced control method provides less sensitivity to the variation of parameters of the electric drive and ensures a dynamic decomposition. The coordinate regulators do not contain the parameters of the electric drive that is typical for classical regulators. The results of this study confirmed the effectiveness of control algorithms and demonstrated their advantages in comparison with traditional ones.

articleTitle: The control of the traction asynchronous electric drive of the miner electric locomotive with dual-mode supply
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article gives the analysis of the power converter structure and offers the ways of its management for power supply of the traction asynchronous electric drive of a miner contact and accumulator electric locomotive according to the “autonomous source of voltage — the asynchronous engine” scheme which provides a possibility of implementation of various laws of management providing operability of the power converter at various levels of supply voltage. The quality indicators of output tension at various ways of its formation are investigated.

articleTitle: Performance enhancement of the relay automatic control system with a fractional-order controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The synthesis of automatic control systems, stable at the unlimited amplification factor, is described. The results of the research of relay automatic control systems with fractional-order controllers of various configurations are presented. The analysis of the obtained results confirms the opportunity of performance enhancement of the relay automatic control system due to the use of the fractional-order control algorithms. The ranges of variation of the fractional-order component powers providing optimal characteristics of the analyzed relay control systems are determined by the method of designing the multifactorial experiment.

articleTitle: Identification of the active resistances of the stator of an induction motor with stator windings dissymmetry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with an equation obtained for determining an active resistance of the stator phase. The equation consists of the ratio of the mean values of the current and voltage integral functions in the steady-state operating mode. We substantiated the possibility of using this method for parametric asymmetry of an induction motor caused by a short-circuit in one of the phases. We obtained dependences of the active resistance and inductance of the phase dissipation of an induction motor in the case of a turn-to-turn fault. We developed the mathematical model of an induction motor in phase coordinates, which takes into account the parametric asymmetry of the individual phases of the induction motor. The limits of this method were determined by the dependence on the turn-to-turn fault.

articleTitle: Determination of electrical engineering business entity's core fields of competence as sources of its competitive advantages
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The use of core fields of competences in formation of competitive advantages of electrical engineering business entity will make it possible to create a fundamentally new approaches to provision of its competitiveness on the basis of analysis of the sources of competitive advantages grounded on competences, determination of the electrical engineering business entity's competitive position and formation of lines providing its competitiveness, on the basis of its available core competences and possibilities for their development, and also the state of business environment and lines of its influence on the business entity. The basic purpose of the paper is to work out the theoretical and methodological principles determining the electrical engineering business entity's core fields of competence as sources of its competitive advantages. T o achieve this purpose the methods of monographic and structural-logical analysis were used. So, formation of core fields of electrical engineering business entities' competences is essential for their competitiveness provision, as by definition, competences are the bases for sustainable competitive advantages of the enterprise, determining its uniqueness in competitive environment.

articleTitle: Synthesis and research of electromechanical systems described by fractional order transfer functions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the application of fractional order desired forms to extend the range of possible fractional controllers adjustment in the synthesis of electromechanical systems loops and to provide better quality of transition processes as compared with integer order controllers. Experimental tests of the fractional order controllers, synthesized by proposed approaches in the control system of frequency converter-induction motor speed, have confirmed the effectiveness in terms of the expansion of adjusting capabilities of PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">γ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller as compared with the classical PID-controller.

articleTitle: Increasing of thermal reliability of a regulated induction motor in non-standard cycle time conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Currently there is no information about the level of cycle time and the duty rating effects on a thermal state and insulation live of induction motor drive, which essentially influences on service reliability. The electrothermal model, which allows considering peculiarities of electromagnetic energy transformation in thermal energy, heat transfer and heat exchange processes, was used for calculation and analysis of the thermal state of induction motor drive. The research has approved that the magnification of cycle time and high value of working slips of the induction motor drive leads to essential growth of its temperature. The estimation of the insulation live which has displayed lowering of the insulation live indexes to 12 times - for the rated induction motor slip s=0.1 and to 50 times - for working induction motor slip s=0.9. Correction current coefficients of the induction motor are defined, supporting its rated thermal conditions.

articleTitle: The problems of training of highly skilled engineers in ukraine in the context of international tendencies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the role of highly skilled engineers under modern economic conditions. The existence of the deficit of engineers in Ukraine, Russia, EU countries and the USA is shown. The analysis of the distribution of students in the fields of study at Ukrainian and European higher educational institutions and a comparative analysis of financing of higher education in Ukraine and EU countries are presented. The main disadvantages of modern domestic engineering training are investigated. A modern trend in the education of young engineers — STEM is proposed.

articleTitle: Electric drive operation modes of above resonance vibration machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the article are considered features of starting mode of the electric drive for the above resonant vibrating machine. For research of starting process was presented a mathematical model of the vibration machine. It is noted that the main load on the drive motors of the vibrating machine is the vibration moment. An expression for determining the nominal torque of the drive motor of a vibrating machine was proposed. The expression, that was proposed taking into account the maximum value of the vibration moment. During using less powerful drive motors, was proposed to use an adjustable electric drive and a sudden change in voltage for rapid passing of the resonant zone during the start of the vibrating machines.

articleTitle: Creating a learning information retrieval system for selection of electromechanical devices for cleaning of gas emissions, wastewater and solid waste
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper suggests a new approach to building of information retrieval system to select electromechanical devices for purification of gas emission, wastewater and solid waste, based on a methodological tools of genetic systematics. The structure of genetic systematic of electromechanical equipment designed to clean exhaust gases, wastewater and solid waste is presented in the paper. The results of the research can be used in the learning process for students of natural and electrical engineering specialties.

articleTitle: Investigation of the direct torque control system of an electromechanical system with a matrix converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The direct torque control system allows to obtain high values of control quality indexes of the induction motor without using coordinate transformations, compensation of crosslinks, determining the parameters of regulators and their adaptation in the conditions of changing the parameters of the equivalent scheme. The matrix converter is attractive for using in a wide range of electromechanical systems, since it does not contain bulky energy storage devices. The paper presents the development of a system for direct torque control of an induction motor powered by a matrix converter. An analysis of the system with a multi-level relay torque controller of induction motor has been carried out.

articleTitle: High voltage power line magnetic field reduction by active shielding means with single compensating coil
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of the space-time characteristics of power frequency magnetic field generated by different types of high voltage power lines is given. The authors show the possibility of reducing magnetic field level with strongly elongated ellipse of space-time characteristics with single compensating coil. The method of active screening system synthesis of power lines magnetic field with uncertainties of plant is improved. An example of active screening system synthesis of magnetic field generated by single-circuit with vertical arrangement of power lines current conductors is given. It is shown that the magnetic field level inside of five-storey building can reduce to sanitary norms by using a single compensating coil.

Author Keywords: high voltage power lines magnetic field

articleTitle: Weight-to-price indicators of electromagnetic systems single-phase transformers and reactors with twisted magnetic circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: New technical proposals for improvement by changing the configuration and position in the space of active elements in order to reduce the material capacity and increase the reliability of single-phase transformers and reactors are presented. Based on mathematical models with partial or integral optimization criteria and a set of independent and dependent control variables, the optimal mass and cost parameters of single-phase electromagnetic systems variants that differ in the structure and configuration of the active elements are determined.

articleTitle: The assessment of the provision of the industry with specialists in electrical engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Professions related to the manufacture, maintenance and repair of electric machines and equipment are the result of the technological advance. Higher educational establishments provide training for specialists in electrical engineering but there is no feedback between meeting the employers' interests, the possibilities of establishments and educational preferences of individuals. The level of the provision at the mining industry enterprises with specialists in electrical engineering has been assessed. The assessment proved that the people whose qualification exceeds the requirements of the position prevail in the engineering staff. The excessive educational level is confirmed by the availability of several educations one of which corresponds to the electrical engineering profile. The educational structures of the employees who occupy the blue-collar positions prove complete neglect of higher education by the person. Under these circumstances it is necessary to provide the consumers of higher education services with complete information about the demand for the specialists of the electrical engineering profile.

articleTitle: Features of defining three-phase transformer no-load parameters by 3D modeling methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Theoretical researches and modeling data are represented on the numerical realization basis by finite elements method of a 3-D mathematical model of a three-phase power transformer, which displays electromagnetic processes transformation features in no-load mode. The article has identified the regularities of magnetic flux density and magnetic field energy distribution for transformer active part in no-load mode. Also their quantitative correlations for core of various phases were established, which define ratios between transformer currents and resistances of direct and reverse sequence. In the research it has been determined that no-load currents are nonsinusoidal and asymmetrical. In harmonic spetrum no-load currents prevail 1-st, 5-th and 7-th harmonic components. But at the same time the first harmonic component dominates. The direct and reverse phase sequence parameters are determined on the basis of the symmetrical components method. This made it possible to propose a correcting technique. It is specifying traditional engineering approach and significantly reducing the error of calculation parameters for the steady-state no-load mode by 7-10 % in comparison to well-known engineering designing techniques of three-phase power transformers.

articleTitle: Transients in a transistor-switched capacitor regulator of a stand-alone induction generator supplying a single-phase load
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents a stand-alone three-phase induction generator with a transistor-switched capacitor regulator tied to the electric machine stator winding. The stator winding phases are interconnected according to the so called Smith winding connection. The generator supplies an isolated single-phase passive load. The transistor-switched capacitor regulator dynamic model has been derived from its equivalent circuits and is augmented with an RCD snubber. The regulator has to regulate the generator voltage according to a bang-bang control algorithm. Transient response of the generator excitation system based on its time domain dynamic model simulation is evaluated after switching on and off the transistor.

articleTitle: The possibilities of the energy method for identifying the parameters of induction motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The possibility of identifying nonlinear parameters of the induction motor equivalent circuit using energy storage devices is considered. A method for identification of electromagnetic parameters of induction motor powered by the energy storage devices. The article proposes an approach to determining motor's parameters taking into account the effect of current displacement in the rotor in the form of the dependence of the rotor's resistance on the current. The article suggests a variant of obtaining the necessary harmonic composition of the voltage and current signals when the induction motor is powered by energy storage devices.

articleTitle: Smart grids and net metering for photovoltaic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Nowadays, there exist different reasons why renewable sources are becoming more and more popular. The rising price of the fossil fuels and serious environmental pollution around the world motivate people to focus on renewable energy sources. These renewable sources represent an inexhaustible energy potential for the future. The importance of the solar energy as a renewable energy resource is growing and represents an important achievement. This paper deals with Smart grids and net metering for photovoltaic systems in Slovenia.

articleTitle: Information and analytical set of tools for assessing efficiency of the civil buildings heating modernization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This thesis deals with the structure and program software of the information and analytical set of tools or assessing efficiency of the civil buildings heating modernization that fully considers the influence factors and allows determining energy-economic decision parameters. The authors suggest using the system of discounting parameters with the limitation of their values for meeting the break-even requirements as an efficiency criterion.

articleTitle: European experience in work-based learning as a challenging innovation for Ukrainian technical higher education
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Higher technical education today is one of the determining factors of reproducing the intellectual and productive human resources of the society, the future success in strengthening the authority of Ukraine as a sovereign, independent, democratic, social and legal state. Under these conditions, it is necessary to find the ways for new partnerships between higher education, enterprises, and students taking into account the needs of all of them. In this context, the study of the work-based models in European universities is of significant interest and may become an important source for comprehensive understanding and creative use of its positive ideas in reforming Ukrainian higher technical education. Participants of the project “Developing European Work Based Learning Approaches and Methods” (DEWBLAM) have developed the European platform for the work-based learning in institutions of higher professional education, which has become the foundation for the introduction of work-based learning models in European universities. The article analyzes various definitions of the work-based learning, the work-based learning models at universities in Germany and the UK, where they have a long history. Analysis of these models enabled defining features and benefits of work-based models, which make them perspective in the Ukrainian higher technical education.

articleTitle: Impact of supply voltage change on the energy performance of boost quasi-resonant converter for radioelectronic equipment power supplies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article presents the impact assessment of supply voltage changes on electromagnetic and electrical processes in transistor switch of boost quasi-resonant converter with zero-current switching (QRC-ZCS) with a parallel resonant circuit. Input voltage affects not only the energy processes in the circuits of pulse converters (PC) with QRC-ZCS and pulse-width modulation (PWM), but also on the duration of switching intervals. The paper shows the evaluation of changes in the duration of switching processes in boost QRC-ZCS with a parallel resonant circuit. The fulfilled investigations have shown that increase of input voltage in parallel QRC-ZCS from 10 to 100 V leads to reduction of dynamic switching intervals, along with almost constant switching intervals of the transistor switch open state and constant transistor switch control pulses duration.

articleTitle: Short term load forecasting as a base core of smart grid integrated intelligent energy management system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The energy sector is one of the major sectors where big steps can be taken towards a sustainable future. This paper represents a study to determine the most effective and accurate technique for Short Term Load Forecasting (STLF) that can be done through Integrated Intelligent Energy Management processes for Smart Grid. The Load Forecasting shall be based on the historical data only. This study compared the results of 56 different scenarios in the number of inputs, different algorithms, and input method. ANN, PSO, MAACPSO, and ANFIS were used as different algorithms. Different input methods include a new proposed method which considers Multi Stages Forecasting. Study verification is done by testing versus other practical STLF methods using traditional inputs. The proposed method results are auspicious with reduced Mean Absolute Error.

articleTitle: Realization techniques of statistical optimization modes of induction drives
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Wide class of electric drives has the stochastic torques of load which essentially worsens the technical and economic indicators of work of such electric drives. Creation of the closed systems with statistically optimal regulators could raise operation efficiency. Optimization criteria of regulating laws for controlled induction electric drives under the stochastic loads are formed. The technique of synthesis for the statistically optimal systems by a minimum criterion of root mean square error of the stabilized parameters is developed. Optimal structures of regulators of the closed electric drives of such class depending on a kind of random loads are defined. Simulation of work of the electric drive in a grain crusher has shown efficiency of a filtration by statically optimal regulator of the high-frequency components of random torques of load, increase of cyclic indicators of energy efficiency of the electric drive, such as cyclic efficiency and power factor, reduction of dispersions of its outlet parameters including the electromagnetic torque, speed and current.

articleTitle: Forecasting of electricity consumption in SmartGrid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the use of wavelet transform for pre data processing when forecasting electricity consumption in Smart Grid. The choice of wavelet transform at oriented basis is proposed in order to increase data processing rate and level of compression as compared with other wavelets.

articleTitle: Parameters of induction machines with a common external massive rotor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The calculation of parameters of electromechanical converter of a multimodule structure with a common hollow massive rotor was submitted. The structure of high-performance electromechanical converter was shown, which includes not only the elements that perform the basic functions of energy conversion of one type into another and provide biomass being processed by fractional, formative and humidity parameters, but also implements a number of related physical and chemical effects to give new properties of biomass and increase the commercial value of the product. Since the material being processed is simultaneously a load-cooling material, the heat transfer and mechanical loading of the brake and motor module are interrelated. Results of industrial tests of the converter are presented. Comparison of experimental and calculated parameters and characteristics as a whole show good convergence of the results.

articleTitle: Research of non-stationary electromagnetic processes in synchronous electric drive
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Mathematical model of transient electromagnetic processes in synchronous electric drive that allows investigating the influence of non-sinusoidal and differential currents and voltages at electromechanical processes are proposed. A mathematical dependence that characterizes the vibration of the rotor under mechanical loading relatively to the synchronous mode is obtained. Simulation of asymmetry power supply of synchronous electrical drive is performed. Electromagnetic and electromechanical processes in a synchronous electric drive are shown. Sharply variable electric loads are exciting and lead to an increase in shaft oscillations that exceed the normative technical documentation has shown.

articleTitle: Symmetrical criterion of random distribution discrimination
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of discrimination of stochastic distributions. In contrast to Kullback's measure, an easily calculated symmetrical metrized criterion is proposed. Its numerical value lies in interval [0,1] irrespective of the type of compared distributions. Examples of calculation of the criterion for typical distributions are given.

articleTitle: Research of regenerative braking of traction permanent magnet synchronous motors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of braking modes of permanent magnet synchronous machines magnets. By studying the equations of a mathematical model, we obtained analytical dependencies demonstrating the possibility of realizing the regenerative braking of the motor at various speeds and in the presence of limitation of the current and voltages values. By mathematical modeling, the difference in the behavior of the main system state variables is shown in regenerative and nonregenerative braking.

articleTitle: A novel method of complex reliability assessment in microgrids with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The complexity of reliability analysis in Microgrids with distributed generation requires new analyses and methods which take into account the modes of distributed generation operation. Such method is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Combined power electronic converter for simultaneous operation of several renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the special power electronic converter which allows simultaneous operation of several different power sources. The sources are AC and DC generators, e.g. wind power generator and photovoltaic source. The DC source is connected to the neutral point of three-phase generator and the inverter acts as a DC-DC boost converter, injecting photovoltaic's energy into the DC bus. The algorithm for valves' switching is developed and simulation results are given. Special control algorithm for inverter's valves, which must have two zero states, provides simultaneous regulation of power from both AC and DC sources. This makes it possible to employ two different sources at lower cost. Analytical dependencies are derived for calculation of optimal operation modes.

articleTitle: Exploring the operational characteristics of a three-phase induction motor with multi-zone stator windings
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The possibility of increasing the operating characteristics of the induction motor by using three-phase multizone stator windings has been studied. A development has established that by working with a three-phase network implies four types of the stator winding design, schemes for laying single-layer, one-two-layer and two-layer windings for stators with a number of grooves from twelve to 90. The induction motor field model in the ANSYS Maxwell package and the dependences of the performance characteristics for the motor with the 0.55 kW power on the distribution of the rated power between sets of three-phase windings have been studied for the induction motor characteristics analysis with the proposed winding. Design recommendations for the asymmetric multi-zone stator winding, depends on the induction motor operating conditions are developed. The carried out experimental researches confirm that the usage of the developed winding allows to increase the inducted motors energy characteristics.

articleTitle: The industrial electrical equipment screened magnetic fields effect on model organisms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The electrical equipment alternating magnetic field action on biological systems is characterized. Using the industrial transformer as an example, a method of its shielding is proposed to reduce the levels of induction of an alternating magnetic field under the action on the model organisms of Daphnia magna Straus. It is established that the optimal way to reduce the level of the alternating magnetic field of an industrial transformer is a combination of two methods: protection of the object by distance and a metal screen. The proposed screening option provides such final indices of the field induction level, under which there are no significant violations of the motor activity of model organisms.

articleTitle: Second order sliding mode control of the inverted pendulum
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the synthesis of interval control system's for inverted pendulum. The contents of this paper are written as follows. Firstly, the generalized interval model of inverted pendulum is given. Then generalized block diagram of control system is proposed and defined generalized control outputs. Furthermore, interval control for inverted pendulum is synthesized and simulations results are given to confirm the proposed approach. Finally, conclusions are written down. The used methods granted asymptotically stability of closed loop pendulum's control system. The proposed approach allows one to create control system of wide range nonlinear dynamical objects. Using of this approach simplifies mathematical model of a nonlinear control object and transform this model to Brunovsky form without performing complicated feedback linearization.

Author Keywords: Brunovsky canonical form of dynamic's equation

articleTitle: Three-phase current harmonics estimation for shunt active power filters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with the on-line estimation of three-phase current harmonics on the base Luenberger observer technique. It is shown that standard observer for positive and negative sequences of each harmonic delivers strong selectivity properties, but has limited speed of convergence. A novel structure of estimator with filtered measured currents is proposed, it guarantees fast asymptotic convergence and simple in tuning. The important feature of the designed estimator is freedom in design of feedback coefficients matrix according to any optimization technique for linear systems, which are stable for any positive tuning gains. Simulation and experimental results proof the theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Functional efficiency enhancement of diesel-electric locomotive traction system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the electric traction system of main line of two-unit freight diesel locomotives. There was offered the modernization of a combined system of diesel engine start-up and a power supply for consumers of an onboard network using a synchronous machine in the starter/generator mode, which allows to increase efficiency of a locomotive electrical equipment usage. There were pointed out the ways of improvement of a regular axle control in order to increase traction and power characteristics of diesel locomotives. Suggested solutions improve the traction and antislip locomotive characteristics by modernizing the traction transmission system and an electrical equipment microprocessor control algorithms.

articleTitle: APF control with the use of the direction of the energy flow determination method in the electric circuit with a nonlinear load
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: On the grounds of the analytical analysis of an electric circuit by a thyristor the method for determining the direction of the energy flow in the electric circuit with a nonlinear load, based on the analysis of the sign of the active power corresponding component, is proposed. It is demonstrated that the correspondence of the sign of the load active power component to the sign of the same component of the network active power signifies that the corresponding harmonic voltage is caused by the network distortion. If the signs do not coincide, the corresponding harmonic voltage is caused by a nonlinear load. The proposed method was taken as the basis for improving the APF control with integrating the separation system into the system of compensator control.

articleTitle: Electrical intelligent system for controlling the formation of monodisperse droplets in granulation devices based on magnetostrictive actuator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of the main shortcomings of existing actuators for obtaining monodisperse droplets is carried out. An electric intelligent control system for the operation of an electromagnetic vibrator is proposed. The system with the help of the actuator drive control unit allows to select the optimum frequency of the oscillations of the working mechanism depending on the productivity of the granulation plant, the speed of the granulation device, the physical and chemical properties of the melt and the environmental conditions. Industrial tests of the proposed electric intellectual system were conducted and ways of its further improvement were outlined.

articleTitle: Thermal process mathematical model in electrical machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The physical and mathematical model of the temperature distributions in an electrical machine arising during its operation is considered in the work. From a mathematical point of view, the electric machine is viewed in the form of a complex three-layer area. In one layer of the machine, internal heat sources act, and in the other two layers heat is transferred conductively or by thermal conductivity. The mathematical model of the thermal process in the electric machine is presented in the form of a boundary value problem for the inhomogeneous three-dimensional heat equation in a complex cylindrical area. An algorithm for solving this problem has been proposed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic compliant of voltage source with relay control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The system of constant-voltage regulation (SCVR) is built on the principle of forced sine-shaped current rise, which is consumed from the circuit and from the relay control. The suggested principle solves the problem of electromagnetic compatibility and terminal processing speed. SCVR has two circuits, two looped circuits. The first one secures looping courses of sine-shaped current, which is consumed from the circuit. The second one is used for voltage stabilization on load. The following research presents the analytical data for relay mode frequency identification while the mains current and voltage are on load formation. Thus, the stabilization system is invariant to the action of disturbances, while the currents consumed from the network retain a sinusoidal form at cosφ = 1. THD is much lower acceptable value specified by the Standard. SCVR permits to generate voltage of different forms. This allows regulating the values and frequencies. With the help of frequency converter SCVR directs energy flow to network - load and load - network.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of operation quality of electric grid with renewable sources of electric energy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Mathematical model for operation quality assessment of electric grid with renewable sources of energy is suggested, the given model takes into consideration balance reliability and voltage quality. The assessment of renewable sources of electric energy impact on functional preparedness of distributed electric grid to provide reliable and quality energy supply was performed, applying the developed model.

articleTitle: On the expediency of introducing the “mathematics — theoretical foundations of electrical engineering” integrated course into the educational process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The main shortcomings in the professional training of future engineers have been identified; the novelty of the approach has been substantiated and the essential characteristic of the “Mathematics - Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering” integrated course has been presented with using the information and communication technologies to enhance the mathematical training of students in electrical engineering majors. The criteria for the mathematical training effectiveness have been determined. The results of the pedagogical experiment that proves the professional orientation effectiveness of the future electricians' mathematical training have been provided by the introduction the “Mathematics - Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering” integrated course in the educational process.

articleTitle: Medical and technical analysis of magnetotherapeutical devices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the paper both conventional and new approach to magnetotherapy are discussed. The stimulation by electromagnetic field (magnetic component) is realized by the coils which generate electromagnetic field of different geometry. New approach allows therapists to realize more precise therapy. New applicators have been designed and mastered and their performance is presented in computer simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Direct power control of a DFIG fed by a two level inverter using SVM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, a direct power control (DPC) is applied to a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind energy. The space vector modulation (SVM) algorithm has a constant switching frequency compared with the classical control; this advantage offers a good total harmonic distortion (THD) rate of the generated currents, reduces the oscillations of the calculated powers and makes the system more robust against significant disturbances. Combined with the direct power control, the system behavior will present a fast response time, which will guarantee a good tracking of the reference signal. The enhanced performances brought by this strategy are studied in the simulation results.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and thermal design of totally enclosed non-ventilated synchronous generator with interior permanent magnets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents electromagnetic and thermal design of 4 kW totally enclosed non-ventilated synchronous generator with interior permanent magnets. In order to verify the design process, the permanent magnet synchronous generator with interior permanent magnets has been manufactured and tested in the laboratory environment.

articleTitle: Twin-objects and double-objects in the structural evolution of electromechanical energy converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The nature of appearance of structural collinearity in the evolution of electromechanical energy converters is analyzed. The key value of generative periodic system of the magnetic field primary sources in the cognition of structure formation mechanism of twin and double heritor-structures is shown in terms of system analyses of structural isotopy and parity principle. The principles and genetic programs of the twin species and double species structure formation in the structural and functional evolution of electromechanical objects are determined. The results of evolution experiments confirming the deterministic connection of the element-information basis of the generating system with the technical evolution of twin and double electromechanical objects are presented. It is established that the vast majority of genetically tolerable Twin-Species belong to the category of implicit. The structural representatives of the last are still absent at this time of technical evolution. Systematized genetic databanks of isotope sources, which form the systemic basis for setting the tasks of genetic prediction and group synthesis of new electromechanical objects of twin species, have been created.

articleTitle: Parameters estimation of transformers gray box model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Several types of models are used for fast transient phenomena analysis of a transformer winding: white box, Black Box and Gray Box Models. The difference between the models arises of how to calculate the parameters. The gray box models are taken into consideration recently. Estimation of the gray box model parameters based on stochastic search optimization method is investigated in this paper. A new method based on Weibull distribution function is used for self and mutual inductance estimation. The number of unknown parameters is reduced by applying this idea. The result of this research is evaluated using measurements on a suitable test object.

articleTitle: The possibilities of Tellegen's theorem in the identification electrotechnical problems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The use of the power balance for obtaining the system of identification equations is analyzed. The prospect of the application of Tellegen's theorem to the identification of the electromechanical objects parameters in the cases of incorrect setting of the modes and in the systems with nonlinearities is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The antisurge protection of a centrifugal compressor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the investigation of the antisurge protection systems and mathematical modeling of systems for gas pumping units that are based on centrifugal compressors with the antisurge valve or bypass. Existing antisurge protection systems for pumping units are reviewed, with revealing a number of disadvantages in the use of blow-off valve or the bypass system. The work of a system of the antisurge protection based on a surge indicator is proposed. It is concluded that the research and improvement of energy efficiency of the antisurge protection system of centrifugal compressors are relevant.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic field of an induction motor with broken rotor bars
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents studies on the determination of the induction motor broken rotor bars on the basis of the analysis of the electromotive forces signals in the measuring windings on the stator in the self-running-out mode. The analysis of the electromagnetic field of the induction motor with broken rotor bars has been performed. Using a chain mathematical model and a model based on the finite element method the induction motor electromagnetic field in the selfrunning-out mode has been calculated. The calculation resulted in obtaining the curves of the electromotive force in the stator windings. It has been shown that these curves contain information signs of broken bars. Using measuring windings has allowed the localized identification of broken rotor bars.

articleTitle: An automated control system neuroregulator synthesis for a linear electromagnet motor based turnout
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to control system development for a turnout electric drive based on a linear electromechanical energy converter as the main tool in the research on electromagnetic-type linear motor operation modes. The problems solved in the article are validation of neural control application for a linear electromagnetic-type motor; synthesis of a neurocontroller for the motor considered; development of a turnout electric drive simulation model with the neural control system application; obtaining of dynamic characteristics of the neural control electric drive.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of transient ground faults in medium voltage networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper reports on the virtual simulator for three-phased medium voltage electric circuits. The simulator allows analyzing transient caused by the grounding faults for Petersen's Coil compensated earthed power system. The results of simulation are also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of solar battery for balance calculations in hybrid electrical grids
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The results of mathematical modeling of a current-voltage characteristic of a solar battery are presented in this paper. It is assumed that power losses caused by nonidentity of solar cell characteristics, commutation, uneven temperature distribution and illumination can be taken into account integrally if the current-voltage characteristic of the solar battery is built on the basis of the current-voltage characteristics of solar cell groups. Mathematical functions for determining the current-voltage characteristic of a group of solar cells are obtained as a result of processing the experimental data of several groups of solar cells within a wide range of temperatures and illumination.

articleTitle: Design of experiment in optimization of permanent magnet synchronous motor performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the possibility of using design of experiment approach by applying Taguchi method to optimize the design of electric motors and to improve their output characteristics. It is noted that optimization can be applied to any system design parameter considering user defined goal. It is shown that Taguchi method is accurate, simple and reliable approach that allows determining the most optimal combinations of parameters for stated objective in highly efficient computational time. On the basis of this optimization method the permanent magnet electrical motor design was optimized by using two different optimization goals, the first one was the reduction of the motor volume and the second one was to maximize its efficiency.

articleTitle: Vibration processes energy in the induction motor when passing resonant frequencies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The features of the oscillation at non-stationary modes of the electromechanical system are examined. The resonant frequency is not equal to natural frequency. The magnitude of its difference depends on the duration of the nonstationary process. For the vibration processes analysis, an imitation model in the form of an electrical analogue with the adopted scaling has been used. The problem of determining the functional dependence between the resonance onset time and the supply voltage frequency change rate in the non-stationary mode has been solved. Energy processes at resonance researched and an assessment of its impact on the electromechanical system is defined. Regression models of non-stationary processes to determine the natural oscillation frequency under certain the frequency at which the maximum of vibration speed occurs and parameters of process, have been obtained.

Author Keywords: rate of change in the frequency

articleTitle: Multiphysics circuits for modeling and simulation in electrical engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents the general classification of Multiphysics problems as applied to the study of electrical devices. The known types of Multiphysics problems, including coupled field problems and field-circuit problems are added with Multiphysics circuits as a complementary class of problems in electrical engineering. Two examples of the multi-circuit problems with both strong and weak coupling are considered for investigation of transient processes in power transformers and high-voltage cable lines.

Author Keywords: weakly and strongly coupled physical processes

articleTitle: Physical simulation of electromagnetic phenomena in transformer equipment under strongly varying loads
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the proposed procedure of physical simulation of non-stationary processes in power transformers intended for supplying the power-intensive arc steel-melting furnaces with strongly varying behavior of the load. This paper demonstrates that non-stationary processes are good reason to research using the scale models based on defining similitude numbers in combination with testing conditions equivalence methods. We represent the findings of experimental researches and physical simulation that confirm efficiency to use the proposed approach while developing the optimal constructive solution for special-purpose transformer equipment.

articleTitle: Small signal modeling and control of PV based QZSI for grid connected applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article proposes modeling and control system design for PV based Quasi-Z-Source Inverter (QZSI) for grid-tied applications. The control system is designed based on two cascaded controllers. Firstly, output current controller designed in the stationary frame. The second is DC-link voltage controller. Also, Modified Direct Incremental Conductance Maximum Power Point Tracking (MDIC-MPPT) method is proposed for quick and accurate MPP optimization. Simulation results are presented to validate the controllers design.

articleTitle: Feedback on installed experience with digital signal processing Petersen coil regulator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper describes a five years operating experience of a new digital sensitive method for the Petersen coil tuning in 6 kV distributed networks. The method evaluates the spectral density of noise, which occurs due to the electric system state change during normal operation.

articleTitle: Proposals for improving the technical state of turbogenerators in excess of the service life
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The state of the world economy, the global economic crisis determined that the first priority in making engineering decisions is economic profitability. This affected on the state and development of the electric power industry, in particular, on the operational policy of repairs and the implementation of replacement schedules for turbogenerators that have fulfilled the service life. Therefore, the main worldwide trend of the development of energy systems and turbine generators was not the replacement of equipment that had worked its life, but the extension of the terms of his work.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of an electromechanical object synthesized as modified recurrent neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Modified recurrent neural networks (MRNN) for the synthesis of linear and nonlinear mathematical models of electromechanical objects are presented. Methods have been developed for the synthesis of these networks, which use known data on the mathematical model of the object and methods for calculating and training neural networks based on the data of the object's operating mode. The proposed method has been verified for the DC-series motor models. The models with high accuracy with a small number of training periods have been confirmed.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and research results of vibromechanical processes in the elements of the powerful synchronous generator end area
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The vibromechanical processes in the generators at the time pressing-out of stator core are reviewed. The authors study the redistribution of linear extensions in tooth support fingers and the vibromechanical processes relating to them.

Author Keywords: tooth support fingers and clamping plates

articleTitle: A new approach to dynamical system's fuzzy controller synthesis: Application of the unstable subsystem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A general approach to the synthesis of the conditionally unstable fuzzy controller is introduced in this paper. This approach allows tuning the output signal of the system for both fast and smooth transient. Fuzzy logic allows combining the properties of several strategies of system tuning dependent on the state of the system. The utilization of instability allows achieving faster transient when the error of the system output is beyond the predefined value. Later the system roots are smoothly moved to the left-hand side of the complex s-plane due to the change of the membership function values. The results of the proposed approaches are compared with the results obtained using traditional methods of controller synthesis.

articleTitle: Heat dissipation due to protective layer of the electroconductive deposition made on textile substrate
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the results of studies on the temperature distribution on the surface of electrically conductive paths created on elastic composite textile substrate in PVD technology. The influence of insulating and protective coatings on the cooling process of thin-film electroconductive elements was presented. Analysis of the temperature distribution was possible while using the thermal imaging. On the basis of these images the ability of heat removing from the elements of the textronics systems secured by protective layers was calculated. The results depend on the type of used insulation (acrylic lacquer or silicone.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of inhomogeneity degree of magnetic field of polygradient magnetic separators for purification of bulk materials
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the main approaches for estimation of homogeneity degree of magnetic field in polygradient medium of magnetic separator. As an indicator of the inhomogeneity of field was accepted inhomogeneity coefficient. It shows how many times the strength of field at research point differs from the strength of homogeneous field. Numerical simulation of distribution of the magnetic field in interpolar working zones in a two-dimensional formulation for six synthesized structures. The plate in form of rectangular triangle was adopted as an elementary monostructure was carried out. Comparative estimation of inhomogeneity degree of magnetic field along characteristic lines of working zones of synthesized structures of magnetic separators polygradient medium has been made. For field inhomogeneity research as characteristic lines were accepted lines that connect the vertices of the opposing triangular plates of the matrix. The results of research can be used to choose the rational structure of polygradient medium and geometric dimensions of its plate elements.

articleTitle: Energy saving in positional frequency regulated asynchronous electric drives by optimizing their acceleration and deceleration times
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article is aimed at the investigation of the influence of the acceleration and deceleration times of the frequency-controlled asynchronous engine in position electric drives with small displacements on the value of electromagnetic energy losses in the indicated engine and the estimation of possible energy savings in the mentioned electric drives by optimizing their acceleration and deceleration times.

articleTitle: Philosophical principles of formation of secondary-school students' readiness for getting a profession of an engineer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the basic philosophical principles of formation of secondary-school students' readiness to get a profession of an engineer. Philosophical opinion in relation to the process of formation of secondary-school students' readiness for getting a profession of an engineer is presented. Schooling problems, becoming an obstacle on the way of getting a profession of an engineer, are determined. The paper also defines and provides the recommendations for teachers and principals to facilitate qualitative approaches to solve the presented scientific problem.

Author Keywords: participants of teaching and educational process

articleTitle: Measurement systems for determining the characteristics of electrical machines
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In today's time, energy efficiency is very important for the sustainable development of modern society. The fact is that most of the produced electrical energy is converted to mechanical energy by electrical machines, which consequently need to operate with as high efficiency as possible. Thus, manufacturers of electrical machines are always faced with new directives and standards that prescribe efficiency classes. In practice, it is necessary to check the performance of each electrical machine, which can be carried out with special hardware, measuring instruments and software. This article presents various types of measurement systems for determining the characteristics of electrical machines. Based on experiences from laboratories already in operation, the possible implementation of measurement systems for electrical machines in practice are presented in detail, considering measurement and control part of the system.

articleTitle: High-speed simulation of electric drives using modified Z-transform (Old technique for modern purpose)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: High-speed method for computer simulation based on the modified z-transform is described in this article. Advantages of such approach of simulation are illustrated by example of the model of the DC electrical drive with PWM chopper.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of magnetic properties of non-linear anisotropic medium in anhysteretic approximation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The research indicates that methods applied to considering magnetic properties of the non-linear anisotropic medium even in the anhysteretic approximation do not always meet the requirements of completeness and mathematical rigor. The authors confirm the efficiency of the energy approach to creating a vector model of the magnetic condition of such media. Special attention is paid to applying the reciprocity principle, which is a fundamental property of reciprocal processes of magnetization. The article presents numerical examples of the suggested approach implementation and new opportunities of its practical application.

articleTitle: Review of modern strategies and tools that provide an application of the competence approach in the system of high education
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article analyzes modern strategies and tools which provide the necessary technologies for education in terms of a competent approach to the curriculum of technical specialties.
