During the analysis, the reviewed strategies were discoveried, namely STEM education, educational communities, Blended Education, aimed on developing of systemic creative thinking, on developing perseverance in achieving the goals of professional and research activities, on developing the ability to work in groups and work independently. The decision on the use of these strategies and instruments in institutions of higher education in combination with the traditional form of training is offered. An approach is offered on the development of training courses in mathematical and natural sciences, taking into account the orientation towards professional disciplines within a particular specialty.

articleTitle: Investigation of the third-order sliding mode control system with different structures of the control objects synthesized by the N-i switching method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The N-i switching method provides optimization for the speed of sliding mode control systems with cascade-subordinate structure of arbitrary order N. It is characterized by the simplicity of the mathematical apparatus and is oriented to easily realizable structures of technical systems, in particular, electric drives. However, this synthesis method involves limiting all the canonical coordinates of the system in transient modes, that is, it reduces the control object to a chain of N integrating links. The present work demonstrates the efficiency of the N-i switching method to systems whose control objects have a structure different from the ideal cascade of integrators.

articleTitle: Design of an optical methane concentration meter, invariant to temperature changes of mine atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The authors propose the method of compensating for temperature drift of the output signal of an optical methane concentration meter for mine atmosphere conditions. This method, unlike the existing ones, uses only a voltage drop signal on the light emitting diode for hardware compensation, while software compensation is done after its changes. That makes it possible to abandon completely the hardware differential circuit design of the meter and an additional temperature sensor. Experimental prototypes of the methane concentration meter based on the proposed method have been designed and produced. While conducting studies of the prototypes, the authors have established the value of additional error of methane concentration measurement with temperature changes in the range from +5 to +35°C, which is not more than ±0.1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vol.</sup>% in the range within 0 and 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vol.</sup>%. The result is twice less than regulatory requirements, so the proposed method allows obtaining measurement results of methane concentration, which are invariant to temperature changes.

articleTitle: Emulation of technological objects at a functional testing of electric drive systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the functional testing of electric drive systems based on using the additional motor torque reference. This value is determined with the help of mathematical model imitating a technological object. In this case, the auxiliary power equipments, workplace and energy expenses are not necessary. A two-mass object with elastic joint is considered as an example. The results of synthesis for the control and the emulation systems are given. The correctness of proposed approach has been confirmed by the experiments.

articleTitle: Principles of hybrid electromechanical structure classes genetic systematics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The problem of determining the taxonomic status of hybrid electromechanical classes of objects is analyzed during the analysis of their genetic programs. For the first time systematic category of hybrid species and hybrid genus are substantiate and hierarchical subordination structure of basic and auxiliary taxonomic classes in the structure of hybrid electromechanical classes of objects are identified. Absolute correlation between the proposed structure of the genetic systematics of electromechanical energy converters hybrid classes and genetically pure electromechanical facilities and systems is shown, which is the reason of its universality for arbitrary functional classes of electromechanical energy converters, which genetic programs are defined by genetically pure and hybrid structures.

Author Keywords: genetic systematics of hybrid electromechanical objects classes

articleTitle: Traction induction motor drive rolling stock wheel pair excessive slide security system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article contains analysis of abnormal modes of traction induction motor drive operation. It identifies main factors that directly influence the character of abnormal modes passing and should be taken into account in case of simulation modeling. The obtained simulation model allows research of abnormal modes in a traction induction motor drive. The quoted result of modeling the motion of the traction induction motor drive along the length of track with a low adhesive coefficient shows that the amount of the rolling stock wheel adhesive coefficient change and the length of track with adverse adhesion conditions significantly influence the history of the transient process. At the same time, application of the traction induction motor drive stator current correction system in its rotation function allows effective control of wheel pair spin development.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of the kinetics of the process of obtaining the metal arsen for the manufacture of semiconductor materials
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The mathematical model of the kinetics of the reaction of arsenic chloride reduction by hydrogen is worked out in the paper. The equation of the kinetics of the gas reaction in the flow, occurring with the volume variation, is obtained. The kinetics equation can be used for processing the experimental data of the research of the process of the arsenic chloride reduction to the metal arsen in the technology of semiconductor materials manufacture. The use of the mathematical model of the gas reaction kinetics made it possible to improve the installation for carrying out the process of AsCl3 reduction to metal As by hydrogen.

articleTitle: GPS cycle computer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article is dedicated to the realization of a GPS cycle computer, of which modules is composed and connected. The first section devoted to realization of GPS cycle computer basing on Arduino Mega 250 microcontroller. In the second section, it deals with the description of program functions which will test and compare with selected parameters of a GPS computer. In the third section, the article describes creation of a bicycle wheel model, the parts of which is built and how these parts work. Finally, it describes the design of the bicycle wheel model and the testing and comparison of the parameters. At the end, the test parameters are compared. It was found that the measured parameters between the stepper motor and the magnetic sensor were identical, but there was a difference between the engine and the GPS cycle engine.

articleTitle: Quality assessment of used materials for pressure vessel design of stirling engine prototype
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to analyse the quality assessment of high temperature resistance steel used for pressure vessels of innovative construction of a linear oscillatory synchronous generator designed to be used in a free-piston Stirling engine. For all testing of pressure vessel and the steel specimens the standard test procedures were used for determining the weldability and quality assessment of high strenght steel.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic multiparameter converter for control of the structure of metal products
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the work the questions of the construction of multiparameter electromagnetic converter with spatially periodic fields is considered. The construction of electromagnetic converter with one pole to highlight certain dominant spatial harmonics is given. The schematic diagram of switching of converter that implements the three parameters method for controlling product parameters is presented. The conclusion about the possibility of using electromagnetic converters with spatially periodic fields for multiparameter measurements is made. Proposed method could be used for the control of long-length metal products (pipelines, cables, shafts, etc.) when there is no access to the surface ends of the product and the ability to apply highly sensitive pass-through electromagnetic converters.

articleTitle: The comparison of energy characteristics of electromagnetic stirrers continuous casting machines
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Three types of electromagnetic stirrers for continuous casting machines are compared. They are an electromagnetic stirrer and synchronous permanent magnet stirrers. Analytical methods for calculating electromagnetic fields and electrical parameters are used. The initial data are presented: sizes of a crystallizer continuous casting machine, parameters of windings, parameters of permanent magnets and used materials. Analysis of magnetic induction, current, power and rotation speed of a molten metal are presented depending on the magnetic field frequency in the crystallizer continuous casting machine. The comparison of energy characteristics for different types of electromagnetic stirrers is presented.

articleTitle: Organization of pseudo volumetric visualization of specialized information for radio-electronic environment analysis systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers experience of creating the system of pseudo-volumetric visualization of information for specialized radio-electronic environment analysis systems on the basis of the developed approaches to effective visualization of signals and their characteristics and proposed methods of pseudo-volumetric visualization. Practical implementation of the software subsystem for the support of visual detection, identification and monitoring of the radio-electronic environment by the proposed visualization methods has been developed. The developed visualization system is easy to use by operator of the automated information data system, it is able to increase informative, and quality of visual representation and recognition of specialized signal information to operator, it has a functional control and navigation interface. The prototype of this visualization system is embedded in the real specialized system of radio-electronic environment analysis.

articleTitle: Study of the torque control algorithm for a doubly-fed full-controlled induction machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to develop and study the torque control algorithm and to construct a mathematical model of an energy generation system based on a full-controlled doubly-fed induction machine (DFIM). A mathematical model of an energy generation system with a DFIM is constructed, on the basis of which a mathematical simulation of the DFIM torque tracking has been performed. An algorithm for vector torque control of the DFIM is studied, which maintains the constancy of the main magnetic flux and the orthogonality of the stator current and magnetic flux vectors. The controllers have been developed which ensure the torque and flux tracking when the electric machine is excited from the rotor side. The study confirms that the considered system of DFIM vector control performs torque tracking with minimum error at a constant air gap flux.

articleTitle: Possibilities of improving the transformers and reactors on the basis of multiple counters of the rods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Technical solutions of transformers and reactors improvement by structural conversion of the elements of the active part are considered. Such conversion consists in the replacement of the traditional circular forming contours of the rods and winding coils by hexagonal and octagonal configurations. The decrease of material consumption and labor intensity of production as well as the increases of electrodynamical stability of the mentioned induction static devices are achieved.

articleTitle: Maximum torque-per-amp tracking control of saturated induction motors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: An improved maximum torque per Ampere (MTPA) controller for induction motor (IM) drives is presented. The proposed MTPA field oriented controller guarantees asymptotic torque tracking of smooth reference trajectories and maximises the torque per Ampere ratio when the developed torque is constant or slow varying. Due to using the closed loop flux observer and high-gain PI controllers for both stator current components the proposed solution provides improved robustness with respect to parameters variations and inverter non-idealities. Experimental tests prove the accuracy of the proposed control over a full torque range. In addition, a higher torque per Ampere ratio is achieved together with an improved efficiency of electromechanical energy conversion.

articleTitle: The system of two-zone direct current motor speed control based on the discrete time equalizer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper is about synthesis of the system of two-zone direct current motor speed control based on the discrete time equalizer. The control object is represented in relative units.
